_note: The shot plan for RefinaBangs, "Why Anne Hathaway Looks So Different With Bangs" - Rahul's brief of 2026-10-29, dialogue verbatim. `lines` is how many script phrases the beat covers; beats.ts derives its bounds from here plus words-vo.ts. VOICEOVER: Rahul's supplied ElevenLabs read (2026-10-29), adopted by docs/preview-review/adopt-vo-bangs.py; the synthesised vesta read is retired.
_argument: One face, one variable. anne-before / anne-fringe are the client's photographs restaged to the house portrait (registered photo:edited): eyes, nose and mouth sit on the same rows in both, so a wipe between them changes the hair and nothing the script says is unchanged. bangs2 / bangs3 are generated and cast as OPPOSITE upper thirds (240px vs 160px hairline-to-brow, read off a grid), so one fringe visibly lands two ways.
_claims: No number about a face is printed. Brackets and guides are drawn between rows READ off each file (landmarks.ts), never anchor()'s fixed boxes, and say WHERE, never HOW MUCH. Anne's beats carry the record's EDITED PHOTOGRAPH label and NO AI-preview chip (it is not a preview); generated faces and the Dossier carry the chip. The Dossier is real screen recordings of Rachel's report (refina-videos/dossier2, ugc-dossier).
_sound: No music bed (Rahul, 2026-10-29). Spot sfx from public/sfx/trio only.
